name: Garibaldi Lake
why: Switchbacks up through old forest to a glacial lake of milky turquoise water under the Sphinx Glacier and the dark pinnacle of the Black Tusk.
book: Free BC Parks day-use pass for Rubble Creek in summer (bcparks.ca, from 7:00 two days before; children 12 and under free). No dogs in the park. Camping only with a reservation.
water: Streams near the top and the lake (treat it).
dangers: Snow on the upper trail until July.
Glacier-fed water is cold: hypothermia if you swim.
Do not go beyond the trail toward the Barrier: rockslide hazard.

points.name: Rubble Creek trailhead
points.note: A parking lot off the Sea-to-Sky Highway, 37 km north of Squamish.

points.name: The Barrier viewpoint
points.note: A side path to the lava wall that holds back the lake.

points.name: Garibaldi Lake
